name: The Space Pad
notes: 3 photos: 1 and 2 are two menu-board layouts (different revisions, overlapping cocktail/food lists) with a 'Provisions'/'Intergalactic Provisions' food section each; photo 3 is a dark, stylized specialty-cocktail list only (drinks, skipped). Cocktails and beers omitted throughout; food items merged across photos 1 and 2, deduping repeated names (Hawaiian O'Dog, Squid Salad, Umeboshi Pineapple, Seaweed Salad). Prices only printed on the photo-1 items.

dishes.name: Halibut Ceviche
dishes.description: Local halibut, mango, lime, passionfruit, jalapeno. Served with tortilla chips or shrimp chips.

dishes.name: Poke Starter
dishes.description: Tuna, sauce, tortilla chips or shrimp chips.

dishes.name: Hawaiian O'Dog
dishes.description: Beef hot dog, pineapple, Japanese plum, spicy aioli, sriracha and togarashi.

dishes.name: Poke Tapas
dishes.description: Ahi tuna, spicy or traditional sauce, sushi rice, sesame seeds, micro wasabi green, sun daisies. Tortilla chips or shrimp chips.

dishes.name: Poke Moon Tower
dishes.description: Ahi tuna, umeboshi pineapple, traditional sauce, seaweed salad, avodillo, sushi rice, togarashi, citrus salt, chili threads, edible ginger.

dishes.name: Togarashi Poke Tower
dishes.description: Ahi tuna, spicy sauce, avocado, jalapenos, sushi rice, sriracha swirl, chili threads, citrus salt, sun daisies.

dishes.name: Space Pad Tacos
dishes.description: Crispy spam, guacamole, pico, pickled red onions. Served with chips and salsa. Gluten free.

dishes.name: Luau Tacos
dishes.description: Crispy spam, umeboshi pineapple, onion, cilantro, spicy aioli, togarashi. Served with chips and salsa. Gluten free.

dishes.name: Chocolate Mousse
dishes.description: Chocolate, whipped cream, strawberries, mint. Gluten free.

dishes.name: Coconut Milk Haupia
dishes.description: Coconut milk pudding, orange, crushed pineapple, blackberry puree, toasted coconut flakes.

dishes.name: Spam Nachos
dishes.description: Spam, salsa, pico de gallo, jalapenos, cotija cheese, pickled red onions, cilantro.

dishes.name: Spam Sliders
dishes.description: Spam, coleslaw, pineapple, Kings Hawaiian slider buns. Your choice of two sides.
